title: 特朗普：俄乌战争“接近结束” 泽连斯基支持举行三方会谈 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 23:18 美国总统特朗普周三（10月21日）再次表示，俄乌战争“接近结束”。美国特使威特科夫与俄罗斯总统普京周三在圣彼得堡会晤后，俄罗斯和乌克兰均表示，愿在美国斡旋下举行三方谈判，寻求结束战争。泽连斯基称，乌克兰支持尽快举行俄乌美三方会谈。 特朗普周三在白宫对记者表示：“前几天，我与普京谈到如何结束他与乌克兰的战争。我认为，我们正朝这个目标靠近。也许，我们从未像现在这样接近（战争结束）。”特朗普并感谢俄罗斯释放被关押四年的美国人斯蒂芬·哈伯德。 乌克兰总统泽连斯基周三表示，支持“尽快”举行俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国三方会谈。此前，克里姆林宫表示，愿于11月中旬举行三方会谈。泽连斯基向媒体表示：“我们获悉，俄罗斯支持由各方代表参加举行三方会谈。美方提议尽快安排这次会谈，我们对此表示支持“。 美国特使威特科夫前一天在奥斯陆与欧洲领导人及乌克兰总统泽连斯基会面，随后前往圣彼得堡。泽连斯基同时呼吁，先按目前的战线停止交火，为谈判迈出第一步。 圣彼得堡会谈持续三小时，俄方形容讨论“深入而坦率”。克里姆林宫外交政策顾问尤里·乌沙科夫表示，莫斯科准备在“11月10日前后”恢复与基辅、华盛顿的三方谈判，即美国中期选举之后。 泽连斯基随后回应称，他支持“尽快”举行三方会谈。泽连斯基表示，“议程很明确：结束战争、推动和平，而且据我理解，为领导人级别的会晤做好一切准备。” 不过，俄乌双方立场似乎仍相距甚远。乌沙科夫表示，乌克兰和欧洲方面在奥斯陆提出、由威特科夫转交普京的结束战争方案，“没有多少实质内容”。 威特科夫则在社交平台X上表示，会谈“具有建设性，后续讨论将在三方谈判框架内继续”。特朗普的女婿库什纳通过视频连线协助他参与了会谈。 威特科夫表示，“虽然仍有大量工作要做，特朗普总统依然决心结束这场战争。” 停火条件分歧未解 俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国曾于2025年举行直接谈判，但几乎没有取得实质进展。美国和以色列发动中东战争后，谈判陷入停顿。 乌沙科夫还提到，各方可能正在筹备普京、美国总统特朗普与中国国家主席习近平的会晤，拟于11月在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间进行。 泽连斯基周三接受福克斯新闻采访时，呼吁将各战线停火作为谈判的第一步。莫斯科此前一直排除这一方案，坚持在停止交火前，先就实质问题达成协议。 俄罗斯尤其要求乌军撤出其在乌克兰东部顿涅茨克地区仍控制的领土，基辅认为这一要求不可接受。 俄释放美国人 将向美运送柴油 圣彼得堡会晤期间，俄罗斯宣布释放一名美国人。这名美国人于2024年因“雇佣兵活动”被判处七年监禁。 特朗普周三表示，获释的斯蒂芬·哈伯德已“在返回美国途中”，俄方释放他没有要求任何“交换条件”。哈伯德是一名年逾七旬的退休教师，特朗普此前曾要求普京将他释放。 普京周三还宣布，首艘向美国运送俄罗斯柴油的油轮将在“两三天内”启航，载有4万吨柴油。俄罗斯主管能源事务的副总理亚历山大·诺瓦克则表示，油轮将于周四出发。 特朗普10月初宣布，美俄已就俄罗斯柴油进入市场达成协议，因而解除部分对俄制裁，引发基辅及其欧洲盟友强烈批评。 这项措施旨在压低美国消费者支付的燃油价格。美国将于11月3日举行国会中期选举，特朗普预计将面临严峻考验。 美乌关系紧张 战事持续 此次圣彼得堡会晤举行之际，华盛顿与基辅近期关系紧张，特朗普和泽连斯基相互发表尖锐批评。 不过，在数日不确定之后，泽连斯基周二对美国恢复导弹预警表示欢迎。这套预警机制可在俄罗斯导弹击中目标前发出警报。 美国当局否认近日蓄意损害乌克兰利益的指控，包括下令停止情报共享，或限制乌军使用的“星链”卫星通信服务运行。 欧盟委员会周三呼吁埃隆·马斯克旗下的太空探索技术公司，紧急恢复乌克兰对“星链”服务的完整使用权限。 尽管外交斡旋持续，前线战斗仍未停止，双方均未取得重大进展。乌克兰方面表示，俄罗斯夜间继续袭击乌克兰能源设施，造成至少四人死亡。

title: 美期中选举将至 民调显示共和党在中西部票仓面临压力 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 23:05 美国共和党力拼在11月3日期中选举保住联邦众议院多数席次，但即使总统特朗普（Donald Trump）2024年在爱阿华州以约13个百分点的优势胜出，共和党如今仍须防守该州4个联邦众议院选区中的3席。随着民调显示民主党支持度逐步上升，加上生活成本、能源价格及特朗普政府关税政策引发民怨，共和党在美国中西部传统票仓，面临愈来愈大的压力。 福斯新闻网（Fox News）报导，共和党人士认为，选举结果仍取决于支持者是否愿意出门投票，但党内也有人私下担忧，特朗普支持度偏低，加上部分政策不受欢迎，可能拖累共和党候选人，让原本具有优势的选区陷入激战，甚至重演2018年民主党席卷国会的“蓝色浪潮”。 报导指出，爱阿华州已成为共和党能否守住众议院多数席次的重要指标。福斯新闻网的选情评估显示，该州4个联邦众议院选区中，除了1席仍被视为共和党稳定掌握，其余3席都可能易手。其中，联邦众议员努恩（Zach Nunn）及米勒－米克斯（Mariannette Miller-Meeks）所属选区被列为民主党略占优势，准备接替退休联邦众议员欣森（Ashley Hinson）的共和党候选人米契尔（Joe Mitchell），则面临胜负难料的选战。 共和党在爱阿华州面临的压力，不只来自民主党动员，也与选民对经济及特朗普政府政策的不满有关。爱阿华州是美国重要农业州，农民与农业相关产业对设备及原物料成本相当敏感。特朗普政府的关税政策推高部分农业设备及其他材料价格，美中贸易战也使中国对美国商品采取报复措施，让仰赖出口的美国农民承受压力。 此外，特朗普决定进口外国牛肉，也成为爱阿华州部分共和党候选人必须面对的争议。当地农业产业与农民是共和党的重要支持基础，若选民认为政府政策损害本地生产者利益，可能影响他们对共和党的支持。 特朗普政府上月宣布，计划在爱阿华州李县（Lee County）兴建一座价值150亿美元的钢铁厂，试图缓解钢铁关税带来的部分冲击。不过，相关投资计画能否及时改善选民对物价与经济的感受，仍有待观察。 爱阿华州的选情变化，也反映共和党在全美乡村地区面临的更广泛问题。过去20年来，美国乡村选民逐渐成为共和党的重要票源。 2024年总统大选时，近三分之二的乡村选民支持特朗普，使共和党得以在许多农村及小城镇选区建立明显优势。然而，最新调查显示，如今表示将在11月期中选举继续支持共和党的乡村选民已不到一半。 福斯新闻网分析，生活成本上涨是造成不满的重要因素。近期调查中，19%的乡村选民将生活成本上升列为最主要的经济问题，汽油与能源价格也名列前茅。特朗普政府试图透过宣传就业成长及人工智能（AI）产业带来的经济机会，降低民众对经济的疑虑，但乡村选民对经济前景仍缺乏信心。 调查显示，认为美国经济状况良好的乡村选民不到四分之一。另有8%受访者将缺乏工作机会及失业列为最主要的经济问题，只有28%认为自己居住的社区有良好或极佳的就业机会。 数据中心的扩张也成为部分乡村居民关切的议题。虽然只有2%的乡村选民将数据中心列为最主要的经济问题，但换算下来，每50名乡村选民就有1人认为，数据中心带来的问题比住房、生活成本或找工作更加严重。 上述经济压力使共和党在爱阿华州、俄亥俄州等美国中西部地区面临更激烈的竞争，也让特朗普2024年曾以两位数百分点优势胜出的部分乡村选区，如今出现两党候选人支持度落在民调误差范围内的情况。 共和党在部分传统优势地区面临的挑战，也反映在候选人的竞选策略上。福斯新闻网指出，怀俄明州共和党联邦参议员候选人葛雷（Chuck Gray）本周推出的电视竞选广告，完全没有提到特朗普或共和党。 这项安排格外引人注意，因为特朗普2024年在怀俄明州获得71.6%的选票，创下他在各州选举中的最高得票率。即使如此，共和党候选人仍选择不在广告中强调与特朗普或共和党的关系，显示部分候选人可能希望将竞选焦点放在自身政见，而非总统的全国性形象。 乡村地区投票率下滑，或部分选民转而支持其他候选人，也可能让共和党在佛罗里达州、密西西比州及南卡罗来纳州等地面临更接近的选战。 今年爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内布拉斯加州及南达科他州的联邦参议员选举，也出现另一项可能影响共和党选情的因素：多名无党籍候选人出马挑战共和党候选人。这些候选人主打反建制立场，提出限制国会议员任期、禁止游说等政见，并将打击贪腐列为重要诉求。福斯新闻网近期民调显示，贪腐是选民最关切的问题之一，让这类主张具有一定吸引力。 这些无党籍候选人都表示，若当选，不会加入民主党或共和党的党团，部分人更主张成立独立党团。民主党在这些州的整体形象仍然偏弱，因此已退出其中3州的相关竞选。蒙大拿州民主党候选人则仍留在选票上，但支持度持续下滑。 福斯新闻网分析，过去当民主党候选人缺乏胜算时，部分民主党支持者可能选择不投票，让共和党候选人以较小差距获胜。但今年无党籍候选人提供了另一种选择，可能吸引对两大政党都不满的选民，进一步压缩共和党的胜选幅度。

报导指出，爱阿华州已成为共和党能否守住众议院多数席次的重要指标。福斯新闻网的选情评估显示，该州4个联邦众议院选区中，除了1席仍被视为共和党稳定掌握，其余3席都可能易手。其中，联邦众议员努恩（Zach Nunn）及米勒－米克斯（Mariannette Miller-Meeks）所属选区被列为民主党略占优势，准备接替退休联邦众议员欣森（Ashley Hinson）的共和党候选人米契尔（Joe Mitchell），则面临胜负难料的选战。 共和党在爱阿华州面临的压力，不只来自民主党动员，也与选民对经济及特朗普政府政策的不满有关。爱阿华州是美国重要农业州，农民与农业相关产业对设备及原物料成本相当敏感。特朗普政府的关税政策推高部分农业设备及其他材料价格，美中贸易战也使中国对美国商品采取报复措施，让仰赖出口的美国农民承受压力。 此外，特朗普决定进口外国牛肉，也成为爱阿华州部分共和党候选人必须面对的争议。当地农业产业与农民是共和党的重要支持基础，若选民认为政府政策损害本地生产者利益，可能影响他们对共和党的支持。 特朗普政府上月宣布，计划在爱阿华州李县（Lee County）兴建一座价值150亿美元的钢铁厂，试图缓解钢铁关税带来的部分冲击。不过，相关投资计画能否及时改善选民对物价与经济的感受，仍有待观察。 爱阿华州的选情变化，也反映共和党在全美乡村地区面临的更广泛问题。过去20年来，美国乡村选民逐渐成为共和党的重要票源。 2024年总统大选时，近三分之二的乡村选民支持特朗普，使共和党得以在许多农村及小城镇选区建立明显优势。然而，最新调查显示，如今表示将在11月期中选举继续支持共和党的乡村选民已不到一半。 福斯新闻网分析，生活成本上涨是造成不满的重要因素。近期调查中，19%的乡村选民将生活成本上升列为最主要的经济问题，汽油与能源价格也名列前茅。特朗普政府试图透过宣传就业成长及人工智能（AI）产业带来的经济机会，降低民众对经济的疑虑，但乡村选民对经济前景仍缺乏信心。 调查显示，认为美国经济状况良好的乡村选民不到四分之一。另有8%受访者将缺乏工作机会及失业列为最主要的经济问题，只有28%认为自己居住的社区有良好或极佳的就业机会。 数据中心的扩张也成为部分乡村居民关切的议题。虽然只有2%的乡村选民将数据中心列为最主要的经济问题，但换算下来，每50名乡村选民就有1人认为，数据中心带来的问题比住房、生活成本或找工作更加严重。 上述经济压力使共和党在爱阿华州、俄亥俄州等美国中西部地区面临更激烈的竞争，也让特朗普2024年曾以两位数百分点优势胜出的部分乡村选区，如今出现两党候选人支持度落在民调误差范围内的情况。 共和党在部分传统优势地区面临的挑战，也反映在候选人的竞选策略上。福斯新闻网指出，怀俄明州共和党联邦参议员候选人葛雷（Chuck Gray）本周推出的电视竞选广告，完全没有提到特朗普或共和党。 这项安排格外引人注意，因为特朗普2024年在怀俄明州获得71.6%的选票，创下他在各州选举中的最高得票率。即使如此，共和党候选人仍选择不在广告中强调与特朗普或共和党的关系，显示部分候选人可能希望将竞选焦点放在自身政见，而非总统的全国性形象。 乡村地区投票率下滑，或部分选民转而支持其他候选人，也可能让共和党在佛罗里达州、密西西比州及南卡罗来纳州等地面临更接近的选战。 今年爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内布拉斯加州及南达科他州的联邦参议员选举，也出现另一项可能影响共和党选情的因素：多名无党籍候选人出马挑战共和党候选人。这些候选人主打反建制立场，提出限制国会议员任期、禁止游说等政见，并将打击贪腐列为重要诉求。福斯新闻网近期民调显示，贪腐是选民最关切的问题之一，让这类主张具有一定吸引力。 这些无党籍候选人都表示，若当选，不会加入民主党或共和党的党团，部分人更主张成立独立党团。民主党在这些州的整体形象仍然偏弱，因此已退出其中3州的相关竞选。蒙大拿州民主党候选人则仍留在选票上，但支持度持续下滑。 福斯新闻网分析，过去当民主党候选人缺乏胜算时，部分民主党支持者可能选择不投票，让共和党候选人以较小差距获胜。但今年无党籍候选人提供了另一种选择，可能吸引对两大政党都不满的选民，进一步压缩共和党的胜选幅度。

title: 英国政府批准北海一处备受争议的天然气田开采项目 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 20:09 英国政府周三批准了在北海开采备受争议的“杰克多”（Jackdaw）天然气项目的计划，旨在展现“务实”态度，以加强该国的能源安全——目前英国正因中东战争导致能源价格飙升而面临压力。 法新社伦敦报道，英国政府批准开采杰克多项目的消息得到了保守派反对党和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的欢迎，但遭到环保主义者的谴责。 工党政府在一份声明中表示，位于阿伯丁以东约240公里的杰克多（Jackdaw）油田开采计划获得批准，这将“保住数百个就业岗位，并为英国经济注入约29亿英镑（34.5亿欧元）” 他指出，所生产的天然气“最早将于本月底”开始供应家庭和商户，且国内产量在高峰期将增长约6%。 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆在议会为这个“务实做法”进行了辩护，此前他被质询了该新项目产生的温室气体排放问题。 伦敦方面表示，仍致力于在2050年前实现碳中和，并向可再生能源转型。伯纳姆先生称：“但即使按照我们雄心勃勃的气候发展路径，未来几十年里，我们仍需要石油和天然气来满足部分能源需求”。 英国政府还宣布设立一项规模为20亿英镑（约合24亿欧元）的生态转型基金，资金来源为北海油气收入。 账单“不会更便宜” 反对在北海进行新钻探的人士反驳称，任何额外的化石能源生产都会导致能源消耗增加，只会延缓能源转型。他们还强调，消费者面临的能源价格并不会因此下降。 工党在2024年上台执政前曾承诺，不会在北海发放新的钻探许可证。 不过，这些承诺并不妨碍批准现有许可证范围内的项目。挪威国家石油公司（Equinor）首席执行官安德斯·奥佩达尔（Anders Opedal）10月初就此接受采访时指出，杰克多“Jackdaw”项目便是如此——该项目最初于2022年由保守党批准，随后经历了一场旷日持久的法律诉讼。 这家挪威国家石油巨头与壳牌（Shell）共同组建了Adura合资企业，主要负责该天然气田的开发。 据Rystad Energy的分析师马特·库珀告诉法新社：“所有基础设施都已就位，所有油井都已钻探完毕”。 距离预算案公布还有一周时间，而受燃油价格上涨推动的通胀率在9月份已达到3.5%，英国首相伯纳姆还强调，这一预计寿命长达11年的天然气项目“将有助于让数百万家庭在这个冬天保持温暖”。 不过，能源部长米亚塔·法恩布莱在接受LBC电台采访时承认：“这并不会让账单金额降低。” “全力以赴” 伯纳姆首相仍面临保守党的压力，该党周三呼吁批准“罗斯班克”项目——这是一个主要位于北海、设得兰群岛以西的石油项目，其法律和政治进程与“杰克道”项目如出一辙。 罗斯班克项目的碳氢化合物储量更大，但其投产所需时间更长，且开采出的石油将被出口到其他国家进行炼制。 伍德·麦肯齐公司的詹姆斯·里德向法新社解释道：“由于国内炼油能力有限，英国大陆架生产的大部分石油都被出口到欧洲的炼油厂。” 政府尚未透露何时就此事作出决定。法恩布莱女士强调，“杰克道”和“罗斯班克”是“两个截然不同的项目”，并特别指出，与原油不同，天然气将直接注入管网。 除了国内压力，英国政府数月来还面临着唐纳德·特朗普呼吁在北海增加钻探的压力。 美国总统在自己的社交媒体平台“Truth Social”上发文称，批准“杰克道”项目是“对英国财富和繁荣的极好消息”。 他补充道：“他们应该在北海钻探方面全力以赴！！！”

title: 法国总理与工会代表会面 马克龙在卡塔尔呼吁采取强硬立场 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 19:23 在又一个实施局部宵禁的夜晚过后，法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼于周三与工会组织代表会面，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙再次呼吁对暴力行为实施者采取“强硬态度”。 法国总理勒科尔尼在新一轮暴力示威前夕，周三上午会见可工会代表讨论安全问题，以防暴力事件重演。对方要求政府就其诉求作出政策回应。 正在卡塔尔结束为期三天海湾之行的法国总统表示，国家最高层在惩处滋事者时“绝不能手软”。 马克龙还宣布将于周四上午与情报部门举行会议，就上周末的事件进行“透明说明”，而周六法国将迎来新一轮抗议活动。 上周六，在抗议“生活成本高企”的示威活动期间，法国多座城市发生了抢劫和暴力事件，期间全法共有3000家商铺遭到抢劫和破坏。 在多哈，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙为自己备受批评的出访行程辩护，承诺法国人将从已达成的能源协议中获得“应有的回报”。他提到，已从卡塔尔获得冬季期间“相当于每月2太瓦时（TWh）的液化天然气（LNG）”。 他还谴责了那些“利用法国（暴力）事件大做文章”的“外国领导人”，此言暗指美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡针对法国暴力事件所发表的言论。 尽管未发现这些事件中存在“明显的外国干涉”，但马克龙谴责了“外国对信息的操纵，这导致许多人——包括外国领导人——发表了既不可接受又愚蠢的言论”。 他最后强调，“任何暴力都是不合法的”，“无论是言语暴力、肢体暴力，还是针对财产或人员的暴力”，并认为在这个问题上“有太多人态度模棱两可”。 在政治层面，法国各派人士周三再次谴责了马克龙政府在这场暴力中失职。 法国总工会（CGT）今天正在考虑是否呼吁加入部分“黄背心”运动成员发起的周六示威号召——该工会的巴黎分部此前已响应了这一号召。 此外，希腊部分学校师生以“法国指明方向”的口号发起示威行动，并呼吁希腊公共部门全面罢工。

title: 台湾在选举前谴责中国网络攻击和散布虚假信息 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 18:13 法新社21日台北消息，台湾情报部门周二表示，中国已加剧针对台湾的网络攻击和散布虚假信息行动，而台湾正准备于11月底举行地方选举。 据台湾国家安全局周二提交给立法院的报告指出：2026年前九个月，台湾平均每天遭受260万次网络攻击，自6月以来这一现象愈演愈烈。 该报告指出，中国“网络军队”将台湾的学术和科研领域、电信行业及国防供应链，作为攻击目标，旨在“干扰台湾政府的国防行动、破坏国际合作并窃取敏感技术”。 另据台湾自由时报引述台湾国安局报告，近期已发现中共结合人工智慧（AI）技术进行网路攻击，包括运用AI代理工具，自动侦察及扫描“我国政府网站的安全弱点，试图提高网路渗透效率”。 报告进一步指出，中共已将AI运用于网路攻击的不同阶段，包括目标侦察、零日漏洞挖掘及社交电邮攻击等活动，藉由自动化工具加快攻击节奏，并提升寻找系统弱点及渗透目标的效率。 据法新社引述台湾情报部门统计，过去九个月内，中共散布了超过250万条虚假信息，而去年同期这一数字约为170万条，主要通过Facebook和Threads平台传播。 这个报告指出，中共“利用了各种渠道”，包括技术和人力手段，“以影响我国选民的偏好和选举结果”。

title: 黄仁勋令皮夹克爱好者蒙羞
description: ANAND GIRIDHARADAS2026年11月12日 It has been a hard week, even for the thick-skinned. 这一周过得可真不容易，哪怕对那些脸皮厚的人来说也是如此。 The news that Jensen Huang, a co-founder of Nvidia, admitted to an affair with a woman whom U.S. intelligence regards as a Chinese spy, has shaken not only Silicon Valley and geopolitics. It also has been an earthquake for the leather-jacket-wearing community. 英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋承认与一名被美国情报机构视为中国间谍的女子发生婚外情，这一消息不仅震动了硅谷和地缘政治，对我们这些皮夹克爱好者来说也无异于一场地震。 We ask ourselves: Was Mr. Huang an easy mark because of his love of high-fashion, motorcycle-adjacent jackets that say both “I don’t care what people think!” and “Do you like how I look?” Did our — I mean, his — armor make him a target? Is an expensive leather jacket on a middle-aged man the new symbol of a honeypot victim? 我们不禁自问：黄仁勋是不是因为迷恋那些出自高端时装品牌、带有摩托车骑士风格的皮夹克，才那么容易上钩的？这些夹克仿佛一边宣称“我才不在乎别人怎么看我”，一边又在问“你觉得我这样穿好看吗”。我们——不对，是他——身上的这层盔甲是否反而让他成了猎物？昂贵的皮夹克难道如今成了中年男人落入美人计圈套的标志？ Without any authorization whatsoever, because that would go against our rebellious grain, I’m speaking out on behalf of the leather-jacket community. We are washed-up musicians and we are dads just trying to feel something again and we are people who want others to assume that we own a Ducati Panigale. And we are here to defend the leather jacket’s name and honor. 我并未得到任何人的授权——毕竟征求授权有违我们骨子里的叛逆精神，但我还是要代表皮夹克爱好者群体站出来说几句。我们当中有过气的音乐人，有试图重新找回一点激情的父亲，也有希望别人以为自己拥有一辆杜卡迪Panigale摩托车的人。今天，我们要捍卫皮夹克的名声与荣誉。 We declare: One man’s fleshly failures should not impugn our second skins. They say not to throw out the baby with the bathwater. Well, similarly, don’t throw out the baby lambskin with the horny human body beneath. 我们宣布：一个男人的肉体过失不应玷污我们的第二层皮肤。俗话说，倒洗澡水时别把孩子一起倒掉。那么同样，也别因为小羊皮夹克下面春心荡漾的肉体就连无辜的小羊皮也一并抛弃。 For many of us, this crisis began long before my fellow graying middle-aged man fell for the oldest trick in the spy book. It began when Mr. Huang had the chutzpah to appropriate our big thing as his big thing. A tech tycoon in his soon-to-be-signature Tom Ford leather jacket was just what we were hoping the rest of the world didn’t see when it looked at us. 对我们许多人来说，这场危机早在那位同样头发花白的中年男子中了间谍套路中最古老的圈套之前就开始了。真正的问题始于黄仁勋竟然厚着脸皮把我们引以为傲的标志性装束变成了他自己的招牌。一个科技大亨穿着后来成为其标志性装扮的汤姆·福特皮夹克——这恰恰是我们最不希望别人看到我们时联想到的形象。 Even then, were we aware that we had a problem? Sure. We may have undiagnosed issues with vulnerability (as reflected in our need for a supplemental dermis), but we’re not stupid. Did we acquire multiple jackets that our spouses smeared as “identical to the last one”? Yes. But a lot of our spouses don’t know the difference between a 1.5-ounce leather and a three-ounce leather, which is like not knowing the difference between Texas and cheese. This was our thing, OK? 我们当时是否意识到问题的存在？当然。我们或许在如何袒露脆弱的一面上有些尚未确诊的心理问题——否则何必给自己再添一层皮肤呢——但我们又不傻。我们是不是买过好几件被配偶讥讽为“跟上一件一模一样”的夹克？没错。但我们的许多配偶根本分不清1.5盎司重的皮革和3盎司重的皮革有什么区别。就像分不清德克萨斯和奶酪的区别一样。拜托，这可是我们自己的爱好，好吗？ Then Mr. Huang, with his own penchant for black leather jackets, had to go and become a household name, the pillar of artificial intelligence, and the man, we were told, without whom the future itself might vanish and the world regress to however it got things done in 2022. 偏偏黄仁勋也喜欢黑色皮夹克，而且非要成为家喻户晓的人物、人工智能产业的支柱。我们还被告知，没有他，未来本身都可能不复存在，世界将倒退到2022年那种不知道靠什么办法做事的年代。 It was annoying to watch a billionaire cosplaying as a rebel, perhaps in order to mask his extraordinary power. Here he was boasting in interviews of not even knowing where his jackets came from, saying his wife and daughter bought them for him, when we in the community could tell you what we ate for dinner any of those fateful days when a new jacket came into our lives. Leather jackets are for people with chips on their shoulders, not microchips in their palms. 看着一个亿万富豪装扮成叛逆者，实在让人恼火。他或许是想借此掩饰自己非同寻常的权力。他还在采访中炫耀，说自己甚至不知道身上的夹克是从哪里买来的，都是妻子和女儿替他购置的。可我们这些真正的皮夹克爱好者，连每一件新夹克来到自己生命中的那个重要日子晚餐吃了什么都记得清清楚楚。皮夹克是给那些心里憋着一股不服气的人穿的，而不是给手握微芯片的人穿的。 People did begin to ask me, a longtime aficionado, if I was emulating Mr. Huang. How dare they! Is it not enough for Mr. Huang to facilitate taking away all the jobs? He wants all the animal skins, too! We in the community began to long for the days when a group of people in leather jackets was called a posse. Now it is known as an A.I. panel. 渐渐地，竟然有人开始问我这个多年的皮夹克爱好者是不是在模仿黄仁勋。他们怎么敢！黄仁勋帮着让人工智能抢走大家的工作还不够，难道连所有动物的皮都想据为己有？我们这些皮夹克爱好者开始怀念从前的日子，那时候，一群穿着皮夹克的人聚在一起叫作一帮硬汉。如今，这种场面却成了人工智能论坛。 At the same time, I identified with some of his comments about the leather lifestyle. These jackets are indeed a great uniform for people who don’t want to think about what to wear every day. They curb the problem of choice even if they signal that you are a problem. And when you belong to a minority group in America, having a signature look is a great way not to be confused with Vivek Ramaswamy. 同时，我认同他关于皮夹克生活方式的一些说法。这些夹克确实是那些不想每天思考穿什么的人的绝佳制服。皮夹克解决了穿什么的难题，却也可能让别人觉得你本人就是个麻烦。而当你在美国属于少数群体时，有一个标志性造型是避免被误认为维韦克·拉马斯瓦米（印度裔美国企业家，共和党政治人物——译注）的好办法。 Then the espionage scandal erupted, and our community of middle-aged leathermen was forced into a reckoning. Are we not as tough as we look? Does the world see us in our skins and think: That guy is one flirty, age-gapped compliment about his panel performance away from potentially divulging secrets? 然后间谍丑闻爆发了，我们这个中年皮夹克群体被迫反思。难道我们并不像外表看起来那么强悍？世人看到我们穿着皮夹克，会不会心想：这家伙只要被一个年轻不少的人暧昧地恭维一句“你在论坛上的表现真棒”，就可能把秘密都抖出来？ The Chinese did not, as far as we know, pursue Mark Zuckerberg, with his T-shirts that look as if they were acquired at the estate sale of someone for whom Ozempic worked a little too well. They did not go after Sam Altman’s hoodies. If there was a target on Mr. Huang’s back, it was made from a buttery, buttery leather. 据我们所知，中国人没有盯上马克·扎克伯格。看看他那些T恤吧，简直像是从某个使用减肥药司美格鲁肽的效果好得过了头的人旧物拍卖会上淘来的。他们也没有盯上萨姆·奥尔特曼的连帽衫。如果黄仁勋背上真有一个靶心，那一定是用柔软得不能再柔软的皮革做成的。 Those of us in the midlife leather-clad community must face what T.S. Eliot called an “overwhelming question”: Do we accessory pivot? Cede the leather jacket to a delusional man trying desperately to look young? Or do we insist that we were that man long before him? 我们这些中年皮夹克爱好者必须面对T·S·艾略特所说的“压倒一切的问题”：我们是不是该换个配饰，另立风格？把皮夹克拱手让给一个不顾一切想显得年轻、却有些自欺欺人的男人？还是坚持说，早在他之前，我们就已经是这种人了？ Anand Giridharadas是《镜中人：美国城市的希望、奋斗与归属感》一书的作者，也是新闻通讯The Ink的出版人。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

It began when Mr. Huang had the chutzpah to appropriate our big thing as his big thing. A tech tycoon in his soon-to-be-signature Tom Ford leather jacket was just what we were hoping the rest of the world didn’t see when it looked at us. 对我们许多人来说，这场危机早在那位同样头发花白的中年男子中了间谍套路中最古老的圈套之前就开始了。真正的问题始于黄仁勋竟然厚着脸皮把我们引以为傲的标志性装束变成了他自己的招牌。一个科技大亨穿着后来成为其标志性装扮的汤姆·福特皮夹克——这恰恰是我们最不希望别人看到我们时联想到的形象。 Even then, were we aware that we had a problem? Sure. We may have undiagnosed issues with vulnerability (as reflected in our need for a supplemental dermis), but we’re not stupid. Did we acquire multiple jackets that our spouses smeared as “identical to the last one”? Yes. But a lot of our spouses don’t know the difference between a 1.5-ounce leather and a three-ounce leather, which is like not knowing the difference between Texas and cheese. This was our thing, OK? 我们当时是否意识到问题的存在？当然。我们或许在如何袒露脆弱的一面上有些尚未确诊的心理问题——否则何必给自己再添一层皮肤呢——但我们又不傻。我们是不是买过好几件被配偶讥讽为“跟上一件一模一样”的夹克？没错。但我们的许多配偶根本分不清1.5盎司重的皮革和3盎司重的皮革有什么区别。就像分不清德克萨斯和奶酪的区别一样。拜托，这可是我们自己的爱好，好吗？ Then Mr. Huang, with his own penchant for black leather jackets, had to go and become a household name, the pillar of artificial intelligence, and the man, we were told, without whom the future itself might vanish and the world regress to however it got things done in 2022. 偏偏黄仁勋也喜欢黑色皮夹克，而且非要成为家喻户晓的人物、人工智能产业的支柱。我们还被告知，没有他，未来本身都可能不复存在，世界将倒退到2022年那种不知道靠什么办法做事的年代。 It was annoying to watch a billionaire cosplaying as a rebel, perhaps in order to mask his extraordinary power. Here he was boasting in interviews of not even knowing where his jackets came from, saying his wife and daughter bought them for him, when we in the community could tell you what we ate for dinner any of those fateful days when a new jacket came into our lives. Leather jackets are for people with chips on their shoulders, not microchips in their palms. 看着一个亿万富豪装扮成叛逆者，实在让人恼火。他或许是想借此掩饰自己非同寻常的权力。他还在采访中炫耀，说自己甚至不知道身上的夹克是从哪里买来的，都是妻子和女儿替他购置的。可我们这些真正的皮夹克爱好者，连每一件新夹克来到自己生命中的那个重要日子晚餐吃了什么都记得清清楚楚。皮夹克是给那些心里憋着一股不服气的人穿的，而不是给手握微芯片的人穿的。 People did begin to ask me, a longtime aficionado, if I was emulating Mr. Huang. How dare they! Is it not enough for Mr. Huang to facilitate taking away all the jobs? He wants all the animal skins, too! We in the community began to long for the days when a group of people in leather jackets was called a posse. Now it is known as an A.I. panel. 渐渐地，竟然有人开始问我这个多年的皮夹克爱好者是不是在模仿黄仁勋。他们怎么敢！黄仁勋帮着让人工智能抢走大家的工作还不够，难道连所有动物的皮都想据为己有？我们这些皮夹克爱好者开始怀念从前的日子，那时候，一群穿着皮夹克的人聚在一起叫作一帮硬汉。如今，这种场面却成了人工智能论坛。 At the same time, I identified with some of his comments about the leather lifestyle. These jackets are indeed a great uniform for people who don’t want to think about what to wear every day. They curb the problem of choice even if they signal that you are a problem. And when you belong to a minority group in America, having a signature look is a great way not to be confused with Vivek Ramaswamy. 同时，我认同他关于皮夹克生活方式的一些说法。这些夹克确实是那些不想每天思考穿什么的人的绝佳制服。皮夹克解决了穿什么的难题，却也可能让别人觉得你本人就是个麻烦。而当你在美国属于少数群体时，有一个标志性造型是避免被误认为维韦克·拉马斯瓦米（印度裔美国企业家，共和党政治人物——译注）的好办法。 Then the espionage scandal erupted, and our community of middle-aged leathermen was forced into a reckoning. Are we not as tough as we look? Does the world see us in our skins and think: That guy is one flirty, age-gapped compliment about his panel performance away from potentially divulging secrets? 然后间谍丑闻爆发了，我们这个中年皮夹克群体被迫反思。难道我们并不像外表看起来那么强悍？世人看到我们穿着皮夹克，会不会心想：这家伙只要被一个年轻不少的人暧昧地恭维一句“你在论坛上的表现真棒”，就可能把秘密都抖出来？ The Chinese did not, as far as we know, pursue Mark Zuckerberg, with his T-shirts that look as if they were acquired at the estate sale of someone for whom Ozempic worked a little too well. They did not go after Sam Altman’s hoodies. If there was a target on Mr. Huang’s back, it was made from a buttery, buttery leather. 据我们所知，中国人没有盯上马克·扎克伯格。看看他那些T恤吧，简直像是从某个使用减肥药司美格鲁肽的效果好得过了头的人旧物拍卖会上淘来的。他们也没有盯上萨姆·奥尔特曼的连帽衫。如果黄仁勋背上真有一个靶心，那一定是用柔软得不能再柔软的皮革做成的。 Those of us in the midlife leather-clad community must face what T.S. Eliot called an “overwhelming question”: Do we accessory pivot? Cede the leather jacket to a delusional man trying desperately to look young? Or do we insist that we were that man long before him? 我们这些中年皮夹克爱好者必须面对T·S·艾略特所说的“压倒一切的问题”：我们是不是该换个配饰，另立风格？把皮夹克拱手让给一个不顾一切想显得年轻、却有些自欺欺人的男人？还是坚持说，早在他之前，我们就已经是这种人了？ Anand Giridharadas是 《镜中人：美国城市的希望、奋斗与归属感》 一书的作者，也是新闻通讯The Ink的出版人。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 黄仁勋事件折射中美外交背后的激烈情报战
description: DAVID PIERSON2026年11月12日9月，在白宫举行的国宴上，特朗普总统（左）和黄仁勋（右）聆听中国国家主席习近平的讲话。 Doug Mills/The New York Times As President Trump and China’s leader, Xi Jinping, prepare to meet next week to extend a fragile trade truce, a fresh espionage scandal has shown that behind their diplomacy is a fierce intelligence rivalry. 就在特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平准备下周会面以延长脆弱的贸易休战期之际，一桩新的间谍丑闻表明，在他们的外交背后，存在一场激烈的情报较量。 At its center is Jensen Huang, the Nvidia leader and an influential ally of Mr. Trump’s, who has acknowledged having an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence officials suspect of spying for Beijing. China has denied the espionage allegation. 处于事件中心的是英伟达领导人、特朗普的重要盟友黄仁勋，他已承认与一名中国女商人发生婚外情，而美国情报官员怀疑这名女商人为北京从事间谍活动。中国否认了这一间谍指控。 Under Mr. Xi, the Chinese Communist Party has built a more sophisticated and assertive spy service that regularly highlights the importance of technological security and of threats posed by the United States. At the same time, the Central Intelligence Agency has said that Chinese companies are a legitimate target for espionage in areas like artificial intelligence, semiconductors and biotechnology. 在习近平的领导下，中国共产党建立了一个更加成熟且强势的间谍机构，该机构经常强调技术安全的重要性以及美国构成的威胁。与此同时，美国中央情报局表示，在人工智能、半导体和生物技术等领域，中国企业是间谍活动的合法目标。 Nvidia’s computer chips power the global A.I. boom and sit at the center of Washington’s efforts to keep that technology out of China’s hands. That makes Mr. Huang, who has lobbied Mr. Trump to ease restrictions on the export of advanced chips to China, a prime target, analysts say. 英伟达的计算机芯片推动了全球人工智能热潮，也成为华盛顿阻止中国掌握人工智能技术的核心所在。分析人士指出，这使得曾游说特朗普放宽对华先进芯片出口限制的黄仁勋成为了首要目标。 “It is not at all surprising, given the centrality of Nvidia to U.S.-China tech competition, and the importance of tech competition in the overall U.S.-China rivalry, that someone like him would be a top target for Chinese intelligence collection,” said Sheena Chestnut Greitens, an expert on Chinese security at the University of Texas at Austin. “鉴于英伟达在中美科技竞争中的核心地位，以及科技竞争在整个中美较量中的重要性，像他这样的人成为中国情报收集的首要目标，一点也不令人惊讶，”得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的中国安全问题专家希娜·切斯特纳特·格雷滕斯说。 这张从CTI视频片段中截取的静态图像显示，黄乐去年在台湾一家餐厅与黄仁勋共进晚餐。 U.S. agencies concluded that the Chinese businesswoman, who goes by Alice Huang, was an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security. Nvidia has said that it is conducting an internal investigation. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment. 美国情报机构得出结论认为，这位名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女商人是中国国家安全部的线人。英伟达表示正在进行内部调查。黄乐尚未对置评请求作出回应。 “It is brazen, and yet I don’t think we should be surprised at all,” said Christopher K. Johnson, a former U.S. government intelligence officer who is now president of China Strategies Group, a risk consultancy. “Whenever the Chinese declare something a national strategic, whole-of-society priority, like they have done with chips and A.I., that implies they will use every tool available to them to work, buy or steal their way to that end.” “这种行为虽然明目张胆，但我认为我们完全不应感到惊讶，”前美国政府情报官员、现任风险咨询公司中国战略集团总裁的克里斯托弗·K·约翰逊说。“每当中国人宣布某件事是国家战略、全社会的优先事项时——就像他们在芯片和人工智能领域所做的那样，这就意味着他们将使用所有可用的工具，通过工作、购买或窃取的方式来达到这一目的。” So far, the scandal has not apparently disrupted plans for Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi to meet next week in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen. Mr. Trump said on Monday that he did not plan to bring the matter up with Mr. Xi. He has repeatedly downplayed reports of Chinese spying and cyberattacks on the United States, arguing that Washington does the same. 迄今为止，这桩丑闻显然并未打乱特朗普和习近平下周在中国南方城市深圳会面的计划。特朗普周一表示，他不打算向习近平提及此事。他曾多次淡化有关中国对美国进行间谍活动和网络攻击的报道，并称华盛顿也在做同样的事情。 That is a contrast with the Biden administration, which confronted China in early 2023 about a spy balloon that was spotted drifting across the continental United States. Official relations between the countries froze for months. 这与拜登政府形成了鲜明对比——2023年初，拜登政府曾就一架被发现漂浮穿越美国本土的间谍气球一事向中国提出交涉。两国官方关系因此冻结了数月。 Mr. Trump’s approach could embolden China to take bigger risks, said Dennis Wilder, a former U.S. intelligence analyst on China and a senior fellow at Georgetown University. 乔治城大学高级研究员、前美国对华情报分析师韦德宁(Dennis Wilder)表示，特朗普的做法可能会让中国胆子更大，愿意冒更大的风险。 “The president’s whole laissez-faire attitude toward spying reassures Beijing that the political blowback from espionage operations will be very manageable,” he said. “总统对间谍活动的整体放任态度让北京确信，间谍行动带来的政治反弹将是非常可控的，”他说。 Mr. Huang was until recently also expected to travel to Shenzhen. When Mr. Xi visited the United States in September, the tech executive was a guest at the White House state dinner. He had joined a presidential trip to Beijing in May at Mr. Trump’s invitation. 直到前不久，黄仁勋原本还计划前往深圳。9月习近平访美时，这位科技高管曾作为嘉宾出席白宫国宴。5月，他应特朗普的邀请，随总统出访北京。 “The president has over and over dismissed Chinese spying by saying that everyone does it,” Mr. Wilder said. “The problem is that no one else does it to the very damaging effect that the Chinese can and do.” “总统一次又一次地对中国间谍活动轻描淡写，说大家都在这么做，”韦德宁说。“问题在于，其他国家无法也不会像中国那样造成如此严重的破坏性后果。” In recent years, Chinese spies have been accused of targeting the phones of American presidential candidates, recruiting U.S. Navy sailors, cultivating political aides, and planting malicious code in power grids and water systems that Americans rely on every day. 近年来，中国间谍被指针对美国总统候选人的手机开展行动，招募美国海军水手，收买政治助理，并在美国人日常依赖的电网和水务系统中植入恶意代码。 Beijing also a history of ruthless counterintelligence operations. From 2010 through 2012, the Chinese government killed or imprisoned 18 to 20 of the C.I.A.’s sources in China, crippling American spying there for years, The New York Times reported in 2017. 北京也有开展无情反间谍行动的历史。据《纽约时报》2017年报道，从2010年到2012年，中国政府杀害或监禁了18到20名中央情报局在中国的线人，导致美国在华间谍活动在此后多年里陷入瘫痪。 Espionage has repeatedly strained relations, at times erupting into diplomatic crises, as when a U.S. Navy surveillance plane collided with a Chinese fighter jet in 2001 near China’s Hainan Island, killing the Chinese pilot. Beijing condemned Washington for spying and held the 24 American crew members for 11 days. 间谍活动屡屡导致两国关系紧张，有时还会引发外交危机。例如2001年，一架美国海军侦察机在中国海南岛附近与一架中国战斗机相撞，导致中国飞行员丧生。北京谴责华盛顿从事间谍活动，并将24名美国机组人员扣留了11天。 A More Sophisticated Spy Agency 一个更成熟的间谍机构 China’s lead intelligence agency, the Ministry of State Security, has transformed from a service that relied on gathering gossip at embassy dinner parties into a sophisticated spy shop that can go toe-to-toe with the C.I.A. with bigger budgets and modern tools like A.I. 中国的首要情报机构国家安全部曾经只是一个依靠在使馆晚宴上收集流言蜚语的机构，如今已经转变成了有雄厚预算和人工智能等现代化工具、能够与中央情报局正面交锋的成熟间谍机构。 Its political standing has risen as well. In 2022, Mr. Xi elevated the ministry’s then chief, Chen Wenqing, to the Communist Party’s Politburo, a council of the 24 most senior national leaders. He was the first spy chief in decades to ascend to that body. 它的政治地位也有所提高。2022年，习近平将该部时任部长陈文清提拔进了由24名国家最高领导人组成的中共中央政治局。他是几十年来首位晋升该机构的情报部门负责人。 The once-shadowy ministry has also stepped into public view, posting a stream of warnings on its WeChat social media account about foreign spies. It has publicized examples of Chinese nationals working for the government and a military contractor in Tokyo and Rome being recruited by C.I.A. officers to provide information about the government or the military. 这个曾经行事隐秘的部门也步入了公众视野，在其微信账号上接连发布关于外国间谍的警告。它还公布了一些案例：在东京和罗马，为政府和军事承包商工作的两位中国公民被中央情报局官员招募，以提供有关政府或军队的信息。 2023年在北京的一次会议上，被提拔进入政治局的情报机构负责人陈文清（右二）。 At the same time, the United States has stepped up its intelligence gathering to include not just military and government targets, but also private Chinese companies, the deputy C.I.A. director, Michael Ellis, told a cybersecurity conference this year. Compared with past geopolitical rivals, China “poses a fundamentally different kind of threat to us because the competition is economic,” Mr. Ellis said. 与此同时，美国中央情报局副局长迈克尔·埃利斯在今年的一次网络安全会议上表示，美国加强了情报收集工作，不仅包括军事和政府目标，还包括中国私营企业。埃利斯说，与过去的地缘政治对手相比，中国“对我们构成了根本上不同类型的威胁，因为这种竞争是经济方面的”。 The C.I.A. has also taken the unusual step of recruiting in public, producing a series of Mandarin-language videos urging disaffected Chinese officials to share secrets with the United States. (The Ministry of State Security’s WeChat account mocked the videos as “crude,” “farcical” and a sign of the C.I.A.’s “baffling incompetence.”) 中央情报局还采取了不同寻常的公开招募举措，制作了一系列普通话视频，敦促心怀不满的中国官员向美国透露机密。（中国国家安全部的微信账号嘲笑这些视频“蹩脚”、“拙劣可笑”，并称这是中央情报局“无能”的标志。） 黄乐曾任一家总部位于新加坡、专门采购英伟达先进芯片的公司Megaspeed的高管。 China Pushes Back 中国的反驳 In China, the case has drawn official denials and questions about what Beijing would stand to gain. 在中国，此案引发了官方的否认，并引发了外界对北京方面能从中获得什么利益的质疑。 Ms. Huang had been an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed that buys advanced Nvidia chips. The United States began restricting sales of advanced chips directly to China in late 2022, but Chinese companies can lease computing power from data centers that use those chips in Southeast Asia, like the ones Megaspeed operates. 黄乐曾是一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡公司的高管，该公司购买先进的英伟达芯片。美国于2022年底开始限制直接向中国销售先进芯片，但中国公司可以从东南亚使用这些芯片的数据中心（例如Megaspeed运营的数据中心）租赁算力。 At the same time, China has also encouraged domestic companies to make do with less powerful domestically produced chips to promote greater national self-reliance, leading some analysts to question the significance of the Nvidia case. 与此同时，中国也鼓励国内企业将就使用功能较弱的国产芯片，以促进国家自给自足，这让一些分析人士对英伟达案的重要性提出质疑。 “China does not want to import so many Nvidia chips,” said Shen Dingli, an international relations scholar in Shanghai. “They are trying to force Chinese companies to use Chinese chips from Huawei.” “中国不想进口那么多英伟达芯片，”上海的国际关系学者沈丁立说。“他们正试图迫使中国企业使用华为的国产芯片。” The Chinese Foreign Ministry has rejected the espionage allegations surrounding Ms. Huang as “nothing but a smear against China.” On Chinese social media platforms, which are heavily censored, comments about Mr. Huang have centered on his extramarital affair. 中国外交部驳斥了围绕黄乐的间谍指控，称其纯属“污蔑抹黑”。在审查严格的中国社交媒体平台上，有关黄仁勋的评论主要集中在他的婚外情上。 Nationalist commentators in China have described the scandal as an effort that brings together American opponents of China, Mr. Trump, and artificial intelligence. 中国的民族主义评论将这桩丑闻描述为一次将美国反对中国、特朗普和人工智能的势力结合在一起的行动。 Ren Yi, a Harvard-educated Chinese blogger who goes by the pen name “Chairman Rabbit,” wrote: “Once again, anti-China politics weaves America’s disparate political causes together.” 曾在哈佛大学就读、笔名为“兔主席”的中国博主任意写道：“反华再次把美国的各种议题联系到了一起。” Berry Wang对本文有研究贡献。 David Pierson报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: DAVID PIERSON 2026年11月12日 9月，在白宫举行的国宴上，特朗普总统（左）和黄仁勋（右）聆听中国国家主席习近平的讲话。 Doug Mills/The New York Times As President Trump and China’s leader, Xi Jinping, prepare to meet next week to extend a fragile trade truce, a fresh espionage scandal has shown that behind their diplomacy is a fierce intelligence rivalry. 就在特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平准备下周会面以延长脆弱的贸易休战期之际，一桩新的间谍丑闻表明，在他们的外交背后，存在一场激烈的情报较量。 At its center is Jensen Huang, the Nvidia leader and an influential ally of Mr. Trump’s, who has acknowledged having an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence officials suspect of spying for Beijing. China has denied the espionage allegation. 处于事件中心的是英伟达领导人、特朗普的重要盟友黄仁勋，他已承认与一名 中国女商人 发生婚外情，而美国情报官员怀疑这名女商人为北京从事间谍活动。中国否认了这一间谍指控。 Under Mr. Xi, the Chinese Communist Party has built a more sophisticated and assertive spy service that regularly highlights the importance of technological security and of threats posed by the United States. At the same time, the Central Intelligence Agency has said that Chinese companies are a legitimate target for espionage in areas like artificial intelligence, semiconductors and biotechnology. 在习近平的领导下，中国共产党建立了一个更加成熟且强势的间谍机构，该机构经常强调技术安全的重要性以及美国构成的威胁。与此同时，美国中央情报局表示，在人工智能、半导体和生物技术等领域，中国企业是间谍活动的合法目标。 Nvidia’s computer chips power the global A.I. boom and sit at the center of Washington’s efforts to keep that technology out of China’s hands. That makes Mr. Huang, who has lobbied Mr. Trump to ease restrictions on the export of advanced chips to China, a prime target, analysts say. 英伟达的计算机芯片 推动了全球人工智能热潮 ，也成为华盛顿阻止中国掌握人工智能技术的核心所在。分析人士指出，这使得曾游说特朗普放宽对华先进芯片出口限制的黄仁勋成为了首要目标。 “It is not at all surprising, given the centrality of Nvidia to U.S.-China tech competition, and the importance of tech competition in the overall U.S.-China rivalry, that someone like him would be a top target for Chinese intelligence collection,” said Sheena Chestnut Greitens, an expert on Chinese security at the University of Texas at Austin. “鉴于英伟达在中美科技竞争中的核心地位，以及科技竞争在整个中美较量中的重要性，像他这样的人成为中国情报收集的首要目标，一点也不令人惊讶，”得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的中国安全问题专家希娜·切斯特纳特·格雷滕斯说。 这张从CTI视频片段中截取的静态图像显示，黄乐去年在台湾一家餐厅与黄仁勋共进晚餐。 U.S. agencies concluded that the Chinese businesswoman, who goes by Alice Huang, was an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security. Nvidia has said that it is conducting an internal investigation . Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment. 美国情报机构得出结论认为，这位名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女商人是中国国家安全部的线人。英伟达表示 正在进行内部调查 。黄乐尚未对置评请求作出回应。 “It is brazen, and yet I don’t think we should be surprised at all,” said Christopher K. Johnson, a former U.S. government intelligence officer who is now president of China Strategies Group, a risk consultancy. “Whenever the Chinese declare something a national strategic, whole-of-society priority, like they have done with chips and A.I., that implies they will use every tool available to them to work, buy or steal their way to that end.” “这种行为虽然明目张胆，但我认为我们完全不应感到惊讶，”前美国政府情报官员、现任风险咨询公司中国战略集团总裁的克里斯托弗·K·约翰逊说。“每当中国人宣布某件事是国家战略、全社会的优先事项时——就像他们在芯片和人工智能领域所做的那样，这就意味着他们将使用所有可用的工具，通过工作、购买或窃取的方式来达到这一目的。” So far, the scandal has not apparently disrupted plans for Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi to meet next week in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen. Mr. Trump said on Monday that he did not plan to bring the matter up with Mr. Xi. He has repeatedly downplayed reports of Chinese spying and cyberattacks on the United States, arguing that Washington does the same. 迄今为止，这桩丑闻显然并未打乱特朗普和习近平下周在中国南方城市深圳会面的计划。特朗普 周一表示 ，他不打算向习近平提及此事。他曾多次淡化有关中国对美国进行间谍活动和网络攻击的报道，并称华盛顿也在做同样的事情。 That is a contrast with the Biden administration, which confronted China in early 2023 about a spy balloon that was spotted drifting across the continental United States. Official relations between the countries froze for months. 这与拜登政府形成了鲜明对比——2023年初，拜登政府曾就一架被发现漂浮穿越美国本土的 间谍气球 一事向中国提出交涉。两国官方关系因此冻结了数月。 Mr. Trump’s approach could embolden China to take bigger risks, said Dennis Wilder, a former U.S. intelligence analyst on China and a senior fellow at Georgetown University. 乔治城大学高级研究员、前美国对华情报分析师韦德宁(Dennis Wilder)表示，特朗普的做法可能会让中国胆子更大，愿意冒更大的风险。 “The president’s whole laissez-faire attitude toward spying reassures Beijing that the political blowback from espionage operations will be very manageable,” he said. “总统对间谍活动的整体放任态度让北京确信，间谍行动带来的政治反弹将是非常可控的，”他说。 Mr. Huang was until recently also expected to travel to Shenzhen. When Mr. Xi visited the United States in September, the tech executive was a guest at the White House state dinner. He had joined a presidential trip to Beijing in May at Mr. Trump’s invitation. 直到前不久，黄仁勋原本还计划前往深圳。9月习近平访美时，这位科技高管曾作为嘉宾出席白宫国宴。5月，他应特朗普的邀请，随总统出访北京。 “The president has over and over dismissed Chinese spying by saying that everyone does it,” Mr. Wilder said. “The problem is that no one else does it to the very damaging effect that the Chinese can and do.” “总统一次又一次地对中国间谍活动轻描淡写，说大家都在这么做，”韦德宁说。“问题在于，其他国家无法也不会像中国那样造成如此严重的破坏性后果。” In recent years, Chinese spies have been accused of targeting the phones of American presidential candidates, recruiting U.S. Navy sailors , cultivating political aides , and planting malicious code in power grids and water systems that Americans rely on every day. 近年来，中国间谍被指 针对美国总统候选人的手机 开展行动，招募 美国海军水手 ，收买 政治助理 ，并在美国人日常依赖的电网和水务系统中 植入恶意代码 。 Beijing also a history of ruthless counterintelligence operations. From 2010 through 2012, the Chinese government killed or imprisoned 18 to 20 of the C.I.A.’s sources in China, crippling American spying there for years, The New York Times reported in 2017 . 北京也有开展无情反间谍行动的历史。据《纽约时报》 2017年报道 ，从2010年到2012年，中国政府杀害或监禁了18到20名中央情报局在中国的线人，导致美国在华间谍活动在此后多年里陷入瘫痪。 Espionage has repeatedly strained relations, at times erupting into diplomatic crises, as when a U.S. Navy surveillance plane collided with a Chinese fighter jet in 2001 near China’s Hainan Island, killing the Chinese pilot. Beijing condemned Washington for spying and held the 24 American crew members for 11 days. 间谍活动屡屡导致两国关系紧张，有时还会引发外交危机。例如2001年，一架美国海军侦察机在中国海南岛附近 与一架中国战斗机相撞 ，导致中国飞行员丧生。北京谴责华盛顿从事间谍活动，并将24名美国机组人员扣留了11天。 A More Sophisticated Spy Agency 一个更成熟的间谍机构 China’s lead intelligence agency, the Ministry of State Security, has transformed from a service that relied on gathering gossip at embassy dinner parties into a sophisticated spy shop that can go toe-to-toe with the C.I.A . with bigger budgets and modern tools like A.I. 中国的首要情报机构国家安全部曾经只是一个依靠在使馆晚宴上收集流言蜚语的机构，如今已经转变成了有雄厚预算和人工智能等现代化工具、能够 与中央情报局正面交锋 的成熟间谍机构。 Its political standing has risen as well. In 2022, Mr. Xi elevated the ministry’s then chief, Chen Wenqing, to the Communist Party’s Politburo, a council of the 24 most senior national leaders. He was the first spy chief in decades to ascend to that body. 它的政治地位也有所提高。2022年，习近平将该部时任部长陈文清提拔进了由24名国家最高领导人组成的中共中央政治局。他是几十年来首位晋升该机构的情报部门负责人。 The once-shadowy ministry has also stepped into public view, posting a stream of warnings on its WeChat social media account about foreign spies. It has publicized examples of Chinese nationals working for the government and a military contractor in Tokyo and Rome being recruited by C.I.A. officers to provide information about the government or the military. 这个曾经行事隐秘的部门也步入了公众视野，在其微信账号上接连发布关于外国间谍的警告。它还公布了一些案例：在东京和罗马， 为政府和军事承包商工作的两位中国公民 被中央情报局官员招募，以提供有关政府或军队的信息。 2023年在北京的一次会议上，被提拔进入政治局的情报机构负责人陈文清（右二）。 At the same time, the United States has stepped up its intelligence gathering to include not just military and government targets, but also private Chinese companies, the deputy C.I.A. director, Michael Ellis, told a cybersecurity conference this year. Compared with past geopolitical rivals, China “poses a fundamentally different kind of threat to us because the competition is economic,” Mr. Ellis said. 与此同时，美国中央情报局副局长迈克尔·埃利斯 在今年的一次网络安全会议上表示 ，美国加强了情报收集工作，不仅包括军事和政府目标，还包括中国私营企业。埃利斯说，与过去的地缘政治对手相比，中国“对我们构成了根本上不同类型的威胁，因为这种竞争是经济方面的”。 The C.I.A. has also taken the unusual step of recruiting in public, producing a series of Mandarin-language videos urging disaffected Chinese officials to share secrets with the United States. (The Ministry of State Security’s WeChat account mocked the videos as “crude,” “farcical” and a sign of the C.I.A.’s “baffling incompetence.”) 中央情报局还采取了不同寻常的公开招募举措，制作了 一系列普通话视频 ，敦促心怀不满的中国官员向美国透露机密。（中国国家安全部的微信账号嘲笑这些视频“蹩脚”、“拙劣可笑”，并称这是中央情报局“无能”的标志。） 黄乐曾任一家总部位于新加坡、专门采购英伟达先进芯片的公司Megaspeed的高管。 China Pushes Back 中国的反驳 In China, the case has drawn official denials and questions about what Beijing would stand to gain. 在中国，此案引发了官方的否认，并引发了外界对北京方面能从中获得什么利益的质疑。 Ms. Huang had been an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed that buys advanced Nvidia chips. The United States began restricting sales of advanced chips directly to China in late 2022, but Chinese companies can lease computing power from data centers that use those chips in Southeast Asia, like the ones Megaspeed operates. 黄乐曾是一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡公司的高管，该公司购买先进的英伟达芯片。美国于2022年底开始限制直接向中国销售先进芯片，但中国公司可以从东南亚使用这些芯片的数据中心（例如Megaspeed运营的数据中心）租赁算力。 At the same time, China has also encouraged domestic companies to make do with less powerful domestically produced chips to promote greater national self-reliance, leading some analysts to question the significance of the Nvidia case. 与此同时，中国也鼓励国内企业将就使用功能较弱的国产芯片，以促进国家自给自足，这让一些分析人士对英伟达案的重要性提出质疑。 “China does not want to import so many Nvidia chips,” said Shen Dingli, an international relations scholar in Shanghai. “They are trying to force Chinese companies to use Chinese chips from Huawei.” “中国不想进口那么多英伟达芯片，”上海的国际关系学者沈丁立说。“他们正试图迫使中国企业使用华为的国产芯片。” The Chinese Foreign Ministry has rejected the espionage allegations surrounding Ms. Huang as “nothing but a smear against China.” On Chinese social media platforms, which are heavily censored, comments about Mr. Huang have centered on his extramarital affair. 中国外交部 驳斥了围绕黄乐的间谍指控 ，称其纯属“污蔑抹黑”。在审查严格的中国社交媒体平台上，有关黄仁勋的评论主要集中在他的婚外情上。 Nationalist commentators in China have described the scandal as an effort that brings together American opponents of China, Mr. Trump, and artificial intelligence. 中国的民族主义评论将这桩丑闻描述为一次将美国反对中国、特朗普和人工智能的势力结合在一起的行动。 Ren Yi, a Harvard-educated Chinese blogger who goes by the pen name “Chairman Rabbit,” wrote: “Once again, anti-China politics weaves America’s disparate political causes together.” 曾在哈佛大学就读、笔名为“兔主席”的中国博主任意写道：“反华再次把美国的各种议题联系到了一起。” Berry Wang对本文有研究贡献。 David Pierson 报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 黄仁勋婚外情丑闻将其妻子置于聚光灯下
description: ERIN GRIFFITH, DON CLARK2026年11月12日英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与妻子洛丽·黄相识于俄勒冈州立大学，当时两人都是工程专业的学生。 Carolyn Kaster/Associated Press In November 2021, Jensen Huang attended the annual dinner held by the Semiconductor Industry Association in San Jose, Calif. That night, the trade group gave Mr. Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia, its highest honor, named for the Intel co-founder Robert Noyce. 2021年11月，黄仁勋出席了半导体行业协会在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举办的年度晚宴。当晚，该行业组织向身为英伟达首席执行官的黄仁勋颁发了以英特尔联合创始人罗伯特·诺伊斯命名的最高荣誉。 Mr. Huang arrived early with his wife, Lori Huang, and quickly headed to the bar at the pre-dinner reception, saying the event was the first time he had been out of his house since the Covid lockdown began in March 2020. He introduced Ms. Huang to reporters who clustered nearby, but they mainly talked to him. 黄仁勋与妻子洛丽·黄早早抵达，并迅速走向晚宴前招待会的吧台，称这次活动是他自2020年3月新冠疫情封锁开始以来首次出门。他将洛丽·黄介绍给聚集在附近的记者，但记者们主要还是与他交谈。 By the time Mr. Huang received the award, two hours had passed. The Nvidia leader walked onstage with a bottle of red wine and two glasses, sharing them with a moderator and taking the conversation into unexpected topics. Throughout, Ms. Huang remained in the background. 到黄仁勋领奖时，两个小时已经过去了。这位英伟达领导者拿着一瓶红酒和两个酒杯走上舞台，与主持人分享，并将对话引向意想不到的话题。在此期间，洛丽·黄一直留在幕后。 For more than 40 years, Ms. Huang has been by Mr. Huang’s side as he built his fledgling chip start-up into one of the most valuable companies in the world. Nvidia’s success turned Mr. Huang into an international business star. His face is on sweaters, his signature leather jackets have become collectors items, and his net worth has soared to nearly $150 billion. 40多年来，黄仁勋将他刚刚起步的芯片初创公司打造成全球最具价值的企业，洛丽·黄全程一直陪伴在他身边。英伟达的成功让他成为国际商业明星。他的面孔出现在毛衣上，他的标志性皮夹克成为收藏品，他的净资产飙升至近1500亿美元。 By contrast, Ms. Huang stayed far from the spotlight. 相比之下，洛丽·黄远离聚光灯。 That changed this week, when Mr. Huang, 63, revealed he had an affair with an executive identified by the U.S. government as a Chinese spy. In his admission, which he shared in a message to Nvidia employees, Mr. Huang apologized to his wife, as well as his two children, who both work at Nvidia, thrusting them into the limelight. 这种情况在本周发生了改变，63岁的黄仁勋透露他与一名被美国政府认定为中国间谍的高管发生了婚外情。在向英伟达员工分享的信息中，黄仁勋向他的妻子以及都在英伟达工作的两个孩子道歉，这让他们突然进入了公众的视野。 The bombshell news had implications for U.S. national security and the economy. Nvidia’s role as the A.I. industry’s main supplier of chips makes Mr. Huang a crucial linchpin for an industry that has come to dominate the stock market. 这则重磅新闻对美国国家安全和经济产生了影响。英伟达作为人工智能行业主要芯片供应商的角色使黄仁勋成为了一个已经主导股票市场的行业的关键核心人物。 8月，任职英伟达产品营销高级总监的黄敏珊在北京举行的2026年世界机器人大会上。去年，英伟达机器人产品总监黄黄胜斌在台北南港展览馆。 It also has ramifications for his personal life. Mr. Huang’s admission has fueled speculation about the fate of his 41-year marriage with Ms. Huang, 64. She is president of the Jen-Hsun Lori Huang Foundation, which had $9 billion in assets as of 2024, including $6 billion in fresh funding that year. Of Mr. Huang’s 922 million Nvidia shares, more than half belong to a trust where Mr. Huang and Ms. Huang are the co-trustees, according to financial filings. She is also the sole controller of a trust that owns around $5 billion worth of Nvidia shares. 这也给他的个人生活带来了影响。他的承认引发了关于他与64岁的洛丽·黄41年婚姻命运的猜测。她是黄仁勋与洛丽·黄基金会的主席，截至2024年，该基金会拥有90亿美元资产，其中包括当年60亿美元的新增资金。根据财务文件，在黄仁勋的9.22亿股英伟达股票中，超过一半属于一个信托基金，黄仁勋和洛丽·黄是该信托的共同受托人。她还是一个拥有价值约50亿美元英伟达股票的信托基金的唯一控制人。 Ms. Huang joins a small group of tech titan spouses who have had to grapple with public infidelity. The list includes MacKenzie Scott, the ex-wife of the Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, and Melinda French Gates, ex-wife of the Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates. The billionaire ex-wife of a tech mogul has become such a fixture in American pop culture that it has inspired characters in “The Devil Wears Prada 2” and the Maya Rudolph comedy “Loot.” 洛丽·黄加入了一小群不得不应对公开不忠行为的科技巨头配偶的行列。这份名单包括亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝佐斯的前妻麦肯齐·斯科特，以及微软联合创始人比尔·盖茨的前妻梅琳达·弗兰奇·盖茨。科技大亨的亿万富翁前妻已经成为美国流行文化中的固定形象，以至于启发了《穿普拉达的女王2》(The Devil Wears Prada 2)和玛雅·鲁道夫的喜剧《钱钱钱钱》(Loot)中的角色。 Ms. Huang’s public profile stands out among the current and former spouses of powerful business leaders because of how private she has been. She has not promoted her philanthropic work in interviews or on the conference circuit. 在位高权重的现任和前任商业领袖的配偶中，洛丽·黄的公众形象因其低调私密而显得与众不同。她没有在采访或会议巡回活动中宣传过自己的慈善工作。 “Lori is unusually modest by the standards of billionaire couples,” said George Rush, who formerly coauthored Rush & Molloy, a long-running gossip column at The Daily News. “以亿万富翁夫妇的标准来看，洛丽异乎寻常地低调，”曾在《每日新闻》(The Daily News)共同撰写长期八卦专栏“拉什与莫洛伊”(Rush & Molloy)的乔治·拉什表示。 That adds further intrigue to the political and economic consequences of the affair, Mr. Rush noted. “Bezos and Gates didn’t have this dynamic, where the relationship could move markets and have this global fallout,” he said. “It is one of a kind.” 拉什指出，这使这起婚外情在政治和经济后果上更加引人关注。“贝佐斯和盖茨夫妇的关系不存在这种能够撼动市场并产生全球性影响的特性，”他说。“这是独一无二的。” Nvidia declined to comment and Ms. Huang did not respond to a request for comment. (China has rejected the espionage claims. Alice Huang, the Chinese executive accused of spying for Beijing, has not responded to requests for comment.) 英伟达拒绝置评，洛丽·黄也没有回应置评请求。（中国已否认间谍指控。被指控为北京从事间谍活动的中国高管黄乐未回应置评请求。） Similar to other tech billionaire spouses like Ms. Scott, Ms. Huang was crucial to the start of her husband’s company. 与斯科特等其他科技亿万富翁的配偶类似，洛丽·黄对她丈夫公司的起步至关重要。 She met Mr. Huang as one of a handful of women studying engineering at Oregon State University in the early 1980s. Mr. Huang was her lab partner in an electrical engineering fundamentals class, and he convinced her to join him for a weekly study date. title: 马斯克等硅谷盟友力挺黄仁勋，称其“不可替代”
description: EMMY MARTIN2026年11月12日去年，埃隆·马斯克与黄仁勋出席在沙特阿拉伯举行的一场投资论坛。马斯克和多名科技行业投资人都公开表达了对黄仁勋的支持。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times Within hours of Jensen Huang’s admission on Sunday that he had been unfaithful to his wife, some of Silicon Valley’s most influential investors closed ranks around him. 黄仁勋周日承认对妻子不忠后数小时内，硅谷一些最有影响力的投资人便纷纷站出来力挺他。 Their messages, delivered mostly on social media, were consistent. Mr. Huang’s relationship with a woman identified by U.S. officials as a Chinese spy was a personal failing. Losing the Nvidia chief executive, they argued, would be a far bigger blow to the country, and America couldn’t win the artificial intelligence race without him. 他们主要通过社交媒体发声，传递的信息高度一致：黄仁勋与一名被美国官员认定为中国间谍的女子有染是个人过失。他们认为，若失去这位英伟达首席执行官，对国家将是大得多的打击，没有黄仁勋，美国就无法赢得人工智能竞赛。 “Jensen is one of the greatest entrepreneurs of this generation,” Shaun Maguire, a partner at Sequoia Capital, wrote in a post on Sunday afternoon. He said that Mr. Huang “did something incredibly dumb,” and that it was bad for America, “but my guess is there was no bad intention.” He concluded that Mr. Huang is “irreplaceable for America’s AI leadership.” “黄仁勋是这一代最杰出的企业家之一，”红杉资本合伙人肖恩·马奎尔周日下午发帖写道。他表示，黄仁勋“做了一件极其愚蠢的事”，这对美国不利，“但我猜他并无恶意”。他最后总结说，黄仁勋“对于美国在人工智能领域的领导地位而言，是不可替代的”。 About an hour later, Elon Musk quoted the post and added: “I agree.” 大约一个小时后，埃隆·马斯克转发了这篇帖文，并补充道：“我同意。” The show of loyalty reflects Mr. Huang’s rarefied standing in Silicon Valley. In the three decades since he co-founded Nvidia, he has gone from running a maker of video game graphics cards to presiding over the company at the center of the A.I. boom, now one of the world’s most valuable companies. 这些支持反映了黄仁勋在硅谷举足轻重的地位。自30多年前与他人共同创立英伟达以来，他从一家电子游戏显卡制造商的掌门人一步步成为人工智能热潮核心企业的领导者。如今，英伟达已是全球市值最高的公司之一。 Nvidia’s chips are the scarce resource every A.I. company needs, a position that makes Mr. Huang something of a kingmaker. Decisions about who gets his products, and how many, can shape which start-ups and tech giants pull ahead. Nvidia’s finances are also deeply intertwined with other leading A.I. companies, including OpenAI and Anthropic. 英伟达的芯片是所有人工智能公司都需要的稀缺资源，这让黄仁勋在某种程度上成为了“造王者”。谁获得他的产品、获得多少都可能影响哪些初创企业和科技巨头能够脱颖而出。英伟达的财务也与OpenAI和Anthropic等领先的人工智能公司有着密切联系。 (China has rejected the espionage claims. Alice Huang, the Chinese executive accused of spying for Beijing, has not responded to requests for comment.) （中国否认了相关指控。被指为北京从事间谍活动的中国女高管黄乐[Alice Huang]尚未回应置评请求。） Bill Ackman, the billionaire hedge fund manager, called Mr. Huang “an incredible human” who took “full responsibility as he should,” and urged people to “support him and his family.” Later on Sunday, Mr. Ackman added that he was “not suggesting he gets a free pass.” 亿万富豪、对冲基金经理比尔·阿克曼称黄仁勋是“一个了不起的人”，他“承担了自己理应承担的全部责任”，并呼吁人们“支持他和他的家人”。周日晚些时候，阿克曼又补充说，他“并不是说应该让他免于承担责任”。 On Monday, the investor Gavin Baker argued that many venture capitalists were “patriotic Americans” who believed Mr. Huang’s policy views served the country against China. He wrote that it would be “a disaster for America — and a gift to China — if Jensen goes down.” 周一，投资人加文·贝克主张，许多风险投资家是“爱国的美国人”，他们相信黄仁勋的政策主张有助于美国在对华竞争中取胜。他写道，“如果黄仁勋倒下，对美国将是一场灾难，却是送给中国的一份大礼。” “100% in agreement,” replied Jason Calacanis, a host of the All-In podcast, which is a popular podcast hosted by a group of venture capitalists including David Sacks, President Trump’s former A.I. and crypto czar. “百分之百同意，”杰森·卡拉卡尼斯回复道。他是热门播客节目《All-In》的主持人之一。该节目由一群风险投资家共同主持，其中包括曾任特朗普总统人工智能与加密货币事务主管的戴维·萨克斯。 Antonio Gracias, the founder of Valor Equity Partners and a longtime associate of Mr. Musk, agreed on Tuesday: “America would not be ahead in the AI race without Jensen,” he wrote. “He clearly made a mistake. One mistake does not erase a lifetime of leadership.” 周二，Valor Equity Partners创始人、马斯克的多年商业伙伴安东尼奥·格拉西亚斯也表示赞同。“没有黄仁勋，美国就不可能在人工智能竞赛中领先，”他写道。“他显然犯了一个错误。但一次错误不能抹杀他一生的领导成就。” The All-In hosts have been close to Mr. Huang. During an appearance onstage with the podcast’s hosts in September, Mr. Huang took a phone call from Mr. Trump. 《All-In》的几位主持人与黄仁勋关系密切。今年9月，黄仁勋与该播客的主持人一同登台时，还接到了特朗普的电话。 Mr. Trump, too, has stood by Mr. Huang. “I really believe him,” he said on Monday, recalling a conversation when Mr. Huang told him he did not know that Ms. Huang was a spy. The Times has reported that Mr. Trump was briefed a year ago about intelligence showing that Ms. Huang was an operative for the Chinese government. Mr. Trump on Tuesday demurred when asked whether he received the briefing last year. 特朗普也支持黄仁勋。“我真的相信他，”他周一说，并回忆起黄仁勋告诉他不知道黄乐是间谍的那次谈话。《纽约时报》报道，特朗普一年前听取过情报简报，显示黄乐是中国政府特工。周二，当被问及去年是否收到该简报时，特朗普没有正面回应。 Mr. Huang has been among Washington’s most forceful voices against cutting China off from American chips, and has been an ally of Mr. Trump since his return to office. That, Mr. Calacanis acknowledged, makes him and his company “a critical target, and we need to protect them both.” 黄仁勋一直是华盛顿反对切断中国获取美国芯片渠道的最有力声音之一，自特朗普重返白宫以来，他也是特朗普的盟友。卡拉卡尼斯承认，这使黄仁勋及其公司成为“重点针对的目标，我们需要保护他们两者”。 In Congress, the Republican leaders of three influential House committees have asked Mr. Huang to appear for a closed-door briefing on his interactions with Ms. Huang. 在国会，众议院三个具有重要影响力的委员会的共和党领袖已要求黄仁勋出席一场闭门情况通报会，说明他与黄乐之间的交往情况。 The Times reported last month that U.S. officials had concluded Ms. Huang, a former executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore company that bought billions of dollars of Nvidia chips, had been recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security. 《纽约时报》上个月报道称，美国官员认定，黄乐已被中国国家安全部招募。她曾在新加坡公司Megaspeed担任高管，该公司购买了价值数十亿美元的英伟达芯片。 Nvidia’s board has opened an investigation, and says it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised. Beijing dismissed the allegations as smears. 英伟达董事会已经展开调查，并表示目前没有理由认为国家安全或公司机密受到损害。北京方面则斥责这些指控是污蔑抹黑。 Emmy Martin报道科技行业，常驻旧金山，她也是2026-27时报培训项目的成员。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 特朗普政府官员就英伟达事件发生冲突
description: ANA SWANSON, TRIPP MICKLE2026年11月12日左为斯科特·贝森特，右为霍华德·卢特尼克。 The New York Times Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick last week over his handling of a Singaporean company at the heart of revelations about Chinese spying on Nvidia, demanding to know why the United States had not already banned sales of advanced A.I. chips to the firm. 上周，财政部长斯科特·贝森特就对一家新加坡公司的处理方式质问了商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，这家公司处于有关中国对英伟达开展间谍活动的信息披露的核心，他要求解释为何这家公司未被禁止购买美国的先进人工智能芯片。 The exchange, which took place at the White House on Thursday and was described by people briefed on it, highlighted growing tensions inside the Trump administration over A.I. policy in general and the Commerce Department’s posture toward Nvidia in particular. 此次交锋发生在上周四的白宫，据听取了相关简报的人士描述，这凸显出特朗普政府内部在整体人工智能政策上——尤其是商务部对英伟达的姿态上——存在日益紧张的对峙。 The internal debate has only intensified after Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s chief executive, acknowledged he had an affair with a woman who had helped lead the Singaporean data center company, Megaspeed. The woman, Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, has been identified by U.S. intelligence as a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security, The New York Times has reported. 在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名曾参与执掌新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed的女性发生婚外情后，这种内部冲突进一步加剧。据《纽约时报》报道，这位名为黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国籍人士已被美国情报机构认定为中国国家安全部的间谍。 Mr. Lutnick responded to Mr. Bessent that the Commerce Department could now move quickly to put restrictions on Megaspeed in place, said the people briefed on the exchange, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the discussions were private. 听取了此次交锋简报的人士表示，卢特尼克回应贝森特说，商务部现在可以迅速采取行动对Megaspeed实施限制；由于讨论是私下的，这些人士要求匿名。 A spokeswoman for the Commerce Department denied that the conversation between Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick had taken place. She said that the decision about whether to add companies to the entity list was an administration-wide one. 商务部的一位发言人否认贝森特与卢特尼克之间发生过这次对话。她表示，是否将一个企业列入实体清单是一个在全政府层面决策的问题。 The Treasury Department did not provide a comment. 财政部未予置评。 The United States has imposed restrictions since late 2022 on selling advanced chips directly to China. But Megaspeed and other companies have sidestepped those rules by setting up data centers in Southeast Asia to cater to Chinese clients. U.S. officials have also been investigating Megaspeed for potentially diverting those chips illegally into China, a charge that Megaspeed has denied. 自2022年底以来，美国对直接向中国销售先进芯片实施了限制。但Megaspeed及其他公司通过在东南亚建立数据中心规避了这些规定，从而服务于中国客户。美国官员也一直在调查Megaspeed是否可能将这些芯片非法转移至中国，Megaspeed否认了这一指控。 The move to blacklist Megaspeed had earlier been discussed at a meeting of the deputies of cabinet officials, where Jeffrey Kessler, an under secretary in the Commerce Department, deferred on taking action, saying that the decision was up to Mr. Lutnick. 将Megaspeed列入黑名单的举措早前曾在内阁官员副手会议上被讨论过，在会上，商务部副部长杰弗里·凯斯勒推迟了这一举措，称此事应由卢特尼克定夺。 The confrontation between Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick was reported earlier by Axios. 贝森特与卢特尼克之间的对质早前由Axios报道。 In recent months, the fight over how to regulate U.S. technology has increasingly left other departments at odds with officials from the Commerce Department, which oversees technology export rules. Megaspeed’s purchases of more than $4 billion of advanced Nvidia technology have helped to reignite a debate in the administration and Washington more broadly about how rigorous U.S. controls over technology exports should be. 近几个月来，关于如何监管美国技术的争论使其他部门与负责监管技术出口规则的商务部官员产生了越来越多的分歧。Megaspeed购买了价值超过40亿美元的先进英伟达技术，这在政府内部乃至整个华盛顿再度引发了关于美国对技术出口的控制应当有多严格的辩论。 One of the Commerce Department’s most powerful rules is the entity list, a trade blacklist. U.S. companies are prohibited from shipping products to any firm on the entity list without first obtaining a license from the U.S. government. 商务部最强有力的规则之一是实体清单，即一份贸易黑名单。未经美国政府许可，美国公司被禁止向实体清单上的任何企业运送产品。 During the first Trump administration and throughout the Biden administration, the government started to use the entity list more aggressively toward China’s technology sector. In March of last year, the Trump administration also issued a large update to the list, adding more than 80 companies and organizations. 在第一届特朗普政府以及整个拜登政府期间，政府开始更积极地将实体清单用于中国科技行业。在去年3月，特朗普政府还发布了该清单的一次大规模更新，增加了80多家公司和组织。 But the administration has backed off use of the list more recently, as it tries to maintain a trade truce with China. More than a year has passed without any firm being added to the entity list, the longest stretch in 18 years. The Trump administration has considered entity listings of Chinese A.I. firms like Deepseek and Alibaba, but has not yet decided to move forward with them. 但由于试图与中国维持贸易休战，本届政府近期已经减少了对该清单的使用。已有一年多的时间没有任何企业被加入实体清单，这是18年来最长的一段时间。特朗普政府曾考虑将Deepseek和阿里巴巴等中国人工智能企业列入实体清单，但尚未决定推进这些举措。 Still, many Trump officials have argued that Megaspeed should be added. A few months ago, officials at several agencies who oversee technology licensing agreed that Megaspeed should be put on the list, including the State Department. But the Commerce Department, which has final responsibility for issuing rules, did not take action. 尽管如此，许多特朗普政府官员一直主张应将Megaspeed列入。几个月前，包括国务院在内的几个负责监管技术许可的部门均同意应将Megaspeed列入名单。但负责最终发布规则的商务部并未采取行动。 The Commerce Department’s inaction led to frustrations across the administration and to Mr. Bessent’s confrontation with Mr. Lutnick. 商务部的不作为导致了整个政府内部的不满以及贝森特与卢特尼克的对质。 U.S. officials in the Commerce Department began looking into Megaspeed in 2024, after the company started importing billions of dollars’ worth of advanced Nvidia A.I. equipment into Malaysia. Megaspeed had been planning and constructing data centers in Southeast Asia to serve Chinese clients, including Alibaba. That behavior is legal, but U.S. officials were concerned that some of the Nvidia chips the company had bought were illegally routed to China. 在该公司开始向马来西亚进口价值数十亿美元的先进英伟达人工智能设备后，美国商务部官员于2024年开始调查Megaspeed。Megaspeed一直在东南亚规划和建设数据中心，以服务包括阿里巴巴在内的中国客户。这种行为是合法的，但美国官员担心该公司购买的部分英伟达芯片被非法转移到了中国。 Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: ANA SWANSON, TRIPP MICKLE 2026年11月12日 左为斯科特·贝森特，右为霍华德·卢特尼克。 The New York Times Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick last week over his handling of a Singaporean company at the heart of revelations about Chinese spying on Nvidia, demanding to know why the United States had not already banned sales of advanced A.I. chips to the firm. 上周，财政部长斯科特·贝森特就对一家新加坡公司的处理方式质问了商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，这家公司处于有关中国对英伟达开展间谍活动的信息披露的核心，他要求解释为何这家公司未被禁止购买美国的先进人工智能芯片。 The exchange, which took place at the White House on Thursday and was described by people briefed on it, highlighted growing tensions inside the Trump administration over A.I. policy in general and the Commerce Department’s posture toward Nvidia in particular. 此次交锋发生在上周四的白宫，据听取了相关简报的人士描述，这凸显出特朗普政府内部在整体人工智能政策上——尤其是商务部对英伟达的姿态上——存在日益紧张的对峙。 The internal debate has only intensified after Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s chief executive, acknowledged he had an affair with a woman who had helped lead the Singaporean data center company, Megaspeed. The woman, Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, has been identified by U.S. intelligence as a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security, The New York Times has reported . 在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名曾参与执掌新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed的女性发生婚外情后，这种内部冲突进一步加剧。据 《纽约时报》报道 ，这位名为黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国籍人士已被美国情报机构认定为中国国家安全部的间谍。 Mr. Lutnick responded to Mr. Bessent that the Commerce Department could now move quickly to put restrictions on Megaspeed in place, said the people briefed on the exchange, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the discussions were private. 听取了此次交锋简报的人士表示，卢特尼克回应贝森特说，商务部现在可以迅速采取行动对Megaspeed实施限制；由于讨论是私下的，这些人士要求匿名。 A spokeswoman for the Commerce Department denied that the conversation between Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick had taken place. She said that the decision about whether to add companies to the entity list was an administration-wide one. 商务部的一位发言人否认贝森特与卢特尼克之间发生过这次对话。她表示，是否将一个企业列入实体清单是一个在全政府层面决策的问题。 The Treasury Department did not provide a comment. 财政部未予置评。 The United States has imposed restrictions since late 2022 on selling advanced chips directly to China. But Megaspeed and other companies have sidestepped those rules by setting up data centers in Southeast Asia to cater to Chinese clients. U.S. officials have also been investigating Megaspeed for potentially diverting those chips illegally into China, a charge that Megaspeed has denied. 自2022年底以来，美国对直接向中国销售先进芯片实施了限制。但Megaspeed及其他公司通过在东南亚建立数据中心规避了这些规定，从而服务于中国客户。美国官员也一直在调查Megaspeed是否可能将这些芯片非法转移至中国，Megaspeed否认了这一指控。 The move to blacklist Megaspeed had earlier been discussed at a meeting of the deputies of cabinet officials, where Jeffrey Kessler, an under secretary in the Commerce Department, deferred on taking action, saying that the decision was up to Mr. Lutnick. 将Megaspeed列入黑名单的举措早前曾在内阁官员副手会议上被讨论过，在会上，商务部副部长杰弗里·凯斯勒推迟了这一举措，称此事应由卢特尼克定夺。 The confrontation between Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick was reported earlier by Axios. 贝森特与卢特尼克之间的对质早前由Axios报道。 In recent months, the fight over how to regulate U.S. technology has increasingly left other departments at odds with officials from the Commerce Department, which oversees technology export rules. Megaspeed’s purchases of more than $4 billion of advanced Nvidia technology have helped to reignite a debate in the administration and Washington more broadly about how rigorous U.S. controls over technology exports should be. 近几个月来，关于如何监管美国技术的争论使其他部门与负责监管技术出口规则的商务部官员产生了越来越多的分歧。Megaspeed购买了价值超过40亿美元的先进英伟达技术，这在政府内部乃至整个华盛顿再度引发了关于美国对技术出口的控制应当有多严格的辩论。 One of the Commerce Department’s most powerful rules is the entity list, a trade blacklist. U.S. companies are prohibited from shipping products to any firm on the entity list without first obtaining a license from the U.S. government. 商务部最强有力的规则之一是实体清单，即一份贸易黑名单。未经美国政府许可，美国公司被禁止向实体清单上的任何企业运送产品。 During the first Trump administration and throughout the Biden administration, the government started to use the entity list more aggressively toward China’s technology sector. That behavior is legal, but U.S. officials were concerned that some of the Nvidia chips the company had bought were illegally routed to China. 在该公司开始向马来西亚进口价值数十亿美元的先进英伟达人工智能设备后，美国商务部官员于2024年开始调查Megaspeed。Megaspeed一直在东南亚规划和建设数据中心，以服务包括阿里巴巴在内的中国客户。这种行为是合法的，但美国官员担心该公司购买的部分英伟达芯片被非法转移到了中国。 Ana Swanson 报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 Tripp Mickle 报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 黄仁勋再被曝婚外情：知情人称其与英伟达一名女高管有染
description: RYAN MAC, TRIPP MICKLE, GEORGIA GEE2026年11月12日今年3月，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举行的公司年度大会上。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times Jensen Huang, the leader of Nvidia who is under investigation for an affair with a woman who U.S. intelligence determined is a Chinese spy, also had an extramarital relationship with an executive who reports to him, according to five people who worked at the company. 英伟达领导人黄仁勋因与一名被美国情报机构认定为中国间谍的女子发生婚外情而受到调查，据五名曾在该公司工作的人士称，他还与一名下属高管有染。 The relationship, which has not been previously reported, was with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care, said the people, who spoke under the condition of anonymity to describe sensitive information. Under Nvidia’s code of conduct, employees are told to “avoid situations where our actions create conflict” including “personal relationships,” and the company states that it “promptly investigates reports of misconduct.” Many corporations have policies against managers having relationships with subordinates. 这些人因描述敏感信息而要求匿名，他们说，这段此前未被披露的婚外情涉及英伟达医疗保健业务副总裁金伯莉·鲍威尔。根据英伟达的行为准则，员工应“避免自身行为造成利益冲突的情况”，其中包括“私人关系”。公司还表示，会“及时调查有关不当行为的举报”。许多企业都有禁止管理人员与下属发生亲密关系的规定。 Mr. Huang, 63, and Ms. Powell, 48, were captured on video being affectionate at a San Jose, Calif., hotel during a Nvidia conference in March, according to two of the people who worked at the company. The New York Times has not seen the video. 两名曾在英伟达工作的人士透露，今年3月，在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举行的一场英伟达会议期间，63岁的黄仁勋和48岁的鲍威尔被拍到在当地一家酒店举止亲密。《纽约时报》未看到这段视频。 Both Mr. Huang and Ms. Powell are married to other people. 黄仁勋和鲍威尔都是已婚人士。 Mr. Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and has turned it into the premier supplier of artificial intelligence chips, has been under intensifying scrutiny. Last month, The New York Times reported that a Chinese executive he had become close to had been identified by U.S. officials as a Chinese intelligence asset. 黄仁勋在1993年跟他人共同创立英伟达，并将其发展为全球领先的人工智能芯片供应商。他现在受到越来越严格的审视。上个月，《纽约时报》报道，一名与他关系密切的中国高管被美国官员认定为中国情报人员。 This month, after Mr. Huang acknowledged the affair, Nvidia’s board opened an investigation into the matter that is being led by the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. The Republican leaders of three influential House committees have also asked Mr. Huang to appear for a closed-door briefing on his interactions with the woman, who goes by the name Alice Huang. 本月，在黄仁勋承认婚外情后，英伟达董事会对此事展开调查，由Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz负责调查工作。三个有影响力的众议院委员会的共和党领袖还要求黄仁勋就他与这个名为黄乐(Alice Huang)的女子之间的交往情况出席闭门简报会。 China has denied the espionage claims. Ms. Huang, the Chinese executive accused of spying for Beijing, has not responded to requests for comment. 中国否认了间谍指控。被指控为北京从事间谍活动的中国高管黄乐没有回应置评请求。 When reached by phone Wednesday and asked about his relationship with Ms. Powell, Mr. Huang said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly.” He then hung up. 周三，记者通过电话联系黄仁勋，询问他与鲍威尔女士的关系时，黄仁勋回答说：“我认为你不应该直接跟我谈这件事。”随后挂断了电话。 Nvidia declined to provide a statement. Ms. Powell did not immediately respond to a request for comment. 英伟达拒绝发表声明。鲍威尔女士没有立即回应置评请求。 英伟达医疗保健业务副总裁金伯莉·鲍威尔今年6月出席在科罗拉多州阿斯彭举行的一场科技活动。 Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Powell has been discussed inside the company, the five people said. 前述五名知情人士表示，黄仁勋与鲍威尔的关系已在公司内部引发议论。 Ms. Powell joined Nvidia in 2008. She oversees programs that could apply Nvidia’s chip technology to higher education and health care, particularly medical imaging devices, according to the company’s website. 鲍威尔于2008年加入英伟达。据公司网站介绍，她负责英伟达芯片技术在高等教育和医疗保健领域的应用项目，尤其是医学影像设备方面。 Ms. Powell has risen through Nvidia’s ranks. She was promoted to senior director of artificial intelligence business development in 2016, according to her LinkedIn. By late 2017, she was appointed vice president of health care. She attends technology conferences around the world, and delivers speeches on behalf of the company. 鲍威尔在英伟达一路晋升。根据她在领英上的个人资料，2016年，她被提拔为人工智能业务开发高级总监。到2017年底，她被任命为医疗保健业务副总裁。她经常参加世界各地的科技会议，并代表公司发表演讲。 In March, Ms. Powell appeared at GTC, Nvidia’s annual developer conference in San Jose, where she spoke about using A.I. to aid in breakthroughs in health care and biology. Her presentation used cartoon depictions of Mr. Huang. 今年3月，鲍威尔出席了英伟达在圣何塞举行的年度开发者大会GTC，并就如何利用人工智能推动医疗保健和生物学领域的突破发表演讲。她的演示文稿中使用了黄仁勋的卡通形象。 During the conference, Nvidia executives were at a nearby hotel for meetings. Mr. Huang and Ms. Powell were seen being affectionate at the hotel. One bystander captured the interaction on their phone, three people briefed on the incident said. 大会期间，英伟达高管在附近一家酒店举行会议。有人看到黄仁勋与鲍威尔在酒店举止亲密。三名知情人士说，一名旁观者用手机拍下了两人的互动视频。 Mr. Huang’s security witnessed the bystander with their phone and sequestered them, the people said. They made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement. 这些人士表示，黄仁勋的安保人员发现这名在场者用手机拍摄后将其带到一旁，并提出让此人签署保密协议。 Mr. Huang is among a long list of chief executives of American companies who have had relationships with subordinates. Brian Krzanich resigned in 2018 from Intel, the chip maker, after acknowledging a “past consensual relationship” with an employee. 黄仁勋只是众多与下属有过亲密关系的美国企业首席执行官之一。2018年，芯片制造商英特尔的首席执行官布赖恩·克尔扎尼奇承认曾与一名员工存在“双方自愿的亲密关系”，随后辞职。 The following year, McDonald’s removed Steve Easterbrook as its chief executive and later sued him after learning he had violated corporate policies by maintaining sexual relationships with multiple employees. 次年，麦当劳解除了史蒂夫·伊斯特布鲁克的首席执行官职务，后来又对他提起诉讼。此前，公司发现他与多名员工保持性关系，违反了公司政策。 Ryan Mac报道全球科技行业的企业责任相关议题。 Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 Georgia Gee是《纽约时报》爆料热线的新闻研究员。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

Ms. Powell did not immediately respond to a request for comment. 英伟达拒绝发表声明。鲍威尔女士没有立即回应置评请求。 英伟达医疗保健业务副总裁金伯莉·鲍威尔今年6月出席在科罗拉多州阿斯彭举行的一场科技活动。 Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Powell has been discussed inside the company, the five people said. 前述五名知情人士表示，黄仁勋与鲍威尔的关系已在公司内部引发议论。 Ms. Powell joined Nvidia in 2008. She oversees programs that could apply Nvidia’s chip technology to higher education and health care, particularly medical imaging devices, according to the company’s website. 鲍威尔于2008年加入英伟达。据公司网站介绍，她负责英伟达芯片技术在高等教育和医疗保健领域的应用项目，尤其是医学影像设备方面。 Ms. Powell has risen through Nvidia’s ranks. She was promoted to senior director of artificial intelligence business development in 2016, according to her LinkedIn. By late 2017, she was appointed vice president of health care. She attends technology conferences around the world, and delivers speeches on behalf of the company. 鲍威尔在英伟达一路晋升。根据她在领英上的个人资料，2016年，她被提拔为人工智能业务开发高级总监。到2017年底，她被任命为医疗保健业务副总裁。她经常参加世界各地的科技会议，并代表公司发表演讲。 In March, Ms. Powell appeared at GTC, Nvidia’s annual developer conference in San Jose, where she spoke about using A.I. to aid in breakthroughs in health care and biology. Her presentation used cartoon depictions of Mr. Huang. 今年3月，鲍威尔出席了英伟达在圣何塞举行的年度开发者大会GTC，并就如何利用人工智能推动医疗保健和生物学领域的突破发表演讲。她的演示文稿中使用了黄仁勋的卡通形象。 During the conference, Nvidia executives were at a nearby hotel for meetings. Mr. Huang and Ms. Powell were seen being affectionate at the hotel. One bystander captured the interaction on their phone, three people briefed on the incident said. 大会期间，英伟达高管在附近一家酒店举行会议。有人看到黄仁勋与鲍威尔在酒店举止亲密。三名知情人士说，一名旁观者用手机拍下了两人的互动视频。 Mr. Huang’s security witnessed the bystander with their phone and sequestered them, the people said. They made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement. 这些人士表示，黄仁勋的安保人员发现这名在场者用手机拍摄后将其带到一旁，并提出让此人签署保密协议。 Mr. Huang is among a long list of chief executives of American companies who have had relationships with subordinates. Brian Krzanich resigned in 2018 from Intel, the chip maker, after acknowledging a “past consensual relationship” with an employee. 黄仁勋只是众多与下属有过亲密关系的美国企业首席执行官之一。2018年，芯片制造商英特尔的首席执行官布赖恩·克尔扎尼奇承认曾与一名员工存在“ 双方自愿的亲密关系 ”，随后 辞职 。 The following year, McDonald’s removed Steve Easterbrook as its chief executive and later sued him after learning he had violated corporate policies by maintaining sexual relationships with multiple employees. 次年， 麦当劳解除了 史蒂夫·伊斯特布鲁克的首席执行官职务，后来又对他提起诉讼。此前，公司发现他与多名员工保持性关系，违反了公司政策。 Ryan Mac 报道全球科技行业的企业责任相关议题。 Tripp Mickle 报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 Georgia Gee 是《纽约时报》爆料热线的新闻研究员。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 英伟达董事会将召开会议，讨论黄仁勋去留
description: TRIPP MICKLE, MAGGIE HABERMAN2026年11月12日在硅谷，很少有高管像英伟达联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋那样，与自己所在的公司如此密不可分。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times Nvidia’s board of directors was expected to meet on Wednesday to discuss the future of Jensen Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia, according to two people with knowledge of the situation, after revelations that he had an affair with an executive who reports to him as well as with a woman whom U.S. intelligence has identified as a Chinese spy. 据两名知情人士透露，在曝出英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名向其汇报的高管以及一名被美国情报部门认定为中国间谍的女性有婚外情后，英伟达董事会预计将于周三召开会议，讨论黄仁勋的去留问题。 Nvidia didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment. 英伟达没有立即回应置评请求。 Mr. Huang’s potential exit would open an uncertain chapter for Nvidia, the premier maker of artificial intelligence chips, and would have widespread ripple effects. The Silicon Valley firm is a linchpin of the A.I. boom and one of the world’s most valuable public companies, controlling an estimated 90 percent of the market for the computer chips used in the big A.I. projects that are driving the U.S. economy. 黄仁勋若离职，将使这家顶尖的人工智能芯片制造商英伟达迎来充满不确定性的新篇章，并引发广泛的连锁反应。这家硅谷公司是人工智能热潮的关键支柱，也是世界上最有价值的上市公司之一，据估计，在推动美国经济发展的重大人工智能项目所使用的计算机芯片市场中，该公司占据了90%的份额。 That dominance has made Mr. Huang one of the wealthiest people in the world, as well as an ally of President Trump. Mr. Trump was previously informed about Mr. Huang’s relationship with the woman believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset but took no action. He has defended Mr. Huang over the past week, calling him an “honorable man” who did not know the woman was a Chinese agent. 这种主导地位使黄仁勋成为世界上最富有的人之一，也成为特朗普总统的盟友。特朗普此前已被告知黄仁勋与这名被认为是中国情报人员的女性的关系，但没有采取行动。过去一周，他一直为黄仁勋辩护，称他是一个“正直的人”，并表示黄仁勋不知道这名女性是中国特工。 Few Silicon Valley executives, with the exception of Tesla’s Elon Musk and Apple’s Steve Jobs, have been as synonymous with their companies as Mr. Huang, 63. He manages all aspects of Nvidia’s business as chief executive, and his family members have steadily risen through the company’s ranks. He is also Nvidia’s largest individual shareholder with a 3.56 percent stake. He has had such a tight grip on the company that there is no clear successor. 除了特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克和苹果的史蒂夫·乔布斯，很少有哪位硅谷高管能像63岁的黄仁勋那样，与自己的公司如此密不可分。作为首席执行官，他管理着英伟达业务的方方面面，他的家庭成员也在公司内部稳步晋升。他还是英伟达最大的个人股东，持股3.56%。他对公司控制得如此之紧，以至于没有明确的继任者。 Public scrutiny of Mr. Huang began after The New York Times first reported last month that American intelligence agencies had discovered that he had developed a close relationship with a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, who U.S. officials concluded was gathering intelligence for Beijing. 公众对黄仁勋的审视始于《纽约时报》上个月率先发布的报道，报道称美国情报机构发现他与一名中国公民兼芯片买家发展了密切关系，美国官员认定此人正在为北京收集情报。 The chip buyer was Alice Huang or Huang Le, whose biography said she worked in China as a TV reporter before becoming a top executive at a Singapore-based data center company that had become one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. It bought more than $4.8 billion in chips since June 2024. 这名芯片买家是黄乐（音，英文名为Alice Huang）。她的简历显示，她曾在中国担任电视记者，后来成为一家新加坡数据中心公司的高管，该公司已成为英伟达在东南亚最大的客户之一。自2024年6月以来，该公司购买了超过48亿美元的芯片。 China has denied the espionage claims. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment. 中国否认了间谍指控。黄乐没有回应置评请求。 On Wednesday, The Times reported that Mr. Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an executive who reports to him. Under Nvidia’s code of conduct, employees are told to “avoid situations where our actions create conflict” including “personal relationships,” and the company states that it “promptly investigates reports of misconduct.” Many corporations have policies against managers having relationships with subordinates. 周三，《纽约时报》报道称，黄仁勋还与一名向他汇报的女高管有婚外情。根据英伟达的行为准则，员工应“避免因自身行为引发利益冲突的情况”，其中包括“个人关系”，公司声明“会迅速调查对不当行为的报告”。许多公司都有规定，禁止经理与下属发生关系。 This is a developing story. Check back for updates. 本报道仍在持续更新中。请随时关注最新动态。 Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
